scoring_justification: Full recomputation of Hartree-Fock self-consistent solution and diffusion simulation is too heavy for the verifier; check consistency with hidden reference values extracted from the paper’s data.

outputs.description: Grid of self-consistently computed altermagnetic order parameter δm for a range of interaction strengths and diagonal hoppings at two temperatures. The hidden checker selects a subset of grid points and compares δm values to paper-reported references using absolute tolerance.

Time evolution of the ratio sq↓/sq↑ during trap expansion. The hidden checker compares the peak value and the ratio at early times to paper-reported reference data using relative tolerance and trend compliance.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the key altermagnetic quantities directly from the tight-binding Hubbard model. The optical-lattice band-structure fitting and parameter-tunability stages are excluded; the agent works with the specified effective hopping parameters. The contract requires only the two scored CSV artifacts.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for order parameter and squeezing ratio checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper's Figure 2(c) line cut and Figure 4(b) data points.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate digitization of paper figures; tolerances set to accommodate implementation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond to the paper's reported phase diagram and time series, as would be produced by a correct Hartree-Fock implementation.
